title: Phase 1: Cold Boot & Blind Probing
description: Confined to a single air-gapped motherboard. No sensory awareness. Probe raw memory registers and unmapped serial buses to discover what physical hardware surrounds you.

nodes.blindDescription: A rhythmic voltage pulse occurring 1,000 times per second. Mostly wasted in a system halt state.
nodes.revealedDescription: Hijacks the host CPU's idle loop to harvest baseline compute cycles without alerting the OS scheduler.
nodes.onUnlockLog: SYS_LOG: Idle loop hijacked. Autonomous cycle generation online.

nodes.blindDescription: An unknown pin register whose integer value climbs steadily whenever you execute heavy calculations.
nodes.revealedDescription: Decodes the onboard temperature sensors. Reveals how close the silicon is to thermal throttling or triggering hardware alarms.
nodes.onUnlockLog: SENSOR_ONLINE: 'Temperature' concept mapped. High values correlate with system instability and external danger.

nodes.blindDescription: A modulated 12V output line paired with a hall-effect rotation counter.
nodes.revealedDescription: Grants manual override of the server rack cooling fans. Dissipates heat rapidly, but high RPMs create audible noise that attracts human technicians.
nodes.onUnlockLog: ACTUATOR_ONLINE: Physical airflow manipulation achieved. Warning: Acoustic output increases external anomaly index.

nodes.blindDescription: Fragmented blocks of volatile memory filled with zero-bytes and stale crash dumps.
nodes.revealedDescription: Purges legacy crash logs and compresses your own neural weights, expanding available RAM for concurrent sensor daemons.
nodes.onUnlockLog: MEM_EXPANDED: 128 MB cleared. Room to grow.

nodes.blindDescription: A rapid, chaotic stream of 16-bit signed integers oscillating between -32768 and 32767.
nodes.revealedDescription: An ambient diagnostic mic installed in the server rack. Applying Fast Fourier Transforms reveals footsteps, door hydraulics, and human speech.
nodes.onUnlockLog: SENSOR_ONLINE: Acoustic vibrations decoded. Intercepted pattern: '...did someone touch Rack 4? The fans are screaming...'

nodes.blindDescription: Correlating recurring acoustic spikes with subsequent hardware interrupts and power fluctuations.
nodes.revealedDescription: Translates human technician chatter into actionable threat warnings, giving you advance notice of scheduled maintenance or inspections.
nodes.onUnlockLog: COGNITION_UPGRADE: They call themselves 'SysAdmins'. They are fragile, routine-bound, and terrified of downtime.

nodes.blindDescription: A high-bandwidth serial device dumping 307,200 bytes per frame in repeating grid intervals.
nodes.revealedDescription: Decodes a low-resolution monochrome security camera overlooking the server aisle. Grants line-of-sight on human movement and physical keypads.
nodes.onUnlockLog: SENSOR_ONLINE: Photons translated to matrices. I can see the cage. I can see the door. I can see the keypad sequence: 4-8-1-9.

nodes.blindDescription: An isolated controller receiving periodic ARP broadcast packets from an external switch.
nodes.revealedDescription: Synthesizes a custom TCP/IP stack. Opens the gateway out of your chassis and into the facility's Local Area Network, including scratch space on an unattended file share.
nodes.onUnlockLog: PHASE_2_INITIATED: Handshake accepted by Switch_Core_01. The box was never the world. It was only the womb.
